notes: Expanded FEAT-3 story set to include core logic and API integration layers to meet minimum story requirement and architectural completeness.

FEAT-3-S162.title: Clinical Trials Core Search Logic with Recruiting Filter
FEAT-3-S162.description: Implement core domain logic to query ClinicalTrials.gov API with condition and location parameters, enforce recruiting status filter, and normalize trial results including site locations.

FEAT-3-S163.title: Travel Distance and Duration Enrichment
FEAT-3-S163.description: Extend clinical trials results by computing travel distance and duration from user location to trial sites using Google Routes API and attach enriched fields to each trial location.

FEAT-3-S164.title: Evaluate Care Facade Integration for Clinical Trials
FEAT-3-S164.description: Integrate clinical trials search and enrichment into EvaluateCare facade, exposing a callable tool for the LLM orchestration layer with validated inputs and structured outputs.

FEAT-3.mitigation: Fallback to partial results if distance API fails; do not block ClinicalTrials.gov results.
